contracts.statusEvidence: docs/ray-traced-scene-profile.md, Status: "`geordi-ray-traced-scene/1` is not yet frozen. No released consumer exists. ... It becomes a frozen contract, after which any incompatible change requires `/2`, only when a release or a consumer first pins it."
notCovered: The JSON Schema expresses the shape, constants, ranges and patterns, not the validator's cross-field and exact-arithmetic rules; docs/ray-traced-scene-profile.md lists them.

geordi-ray-traced-render-receipt/1 shares crates/geordi-ir/src/ray_traced_scene.rs and the GEORDI_E_RT_ prefix, so changes to its Rust items and codes (GEORDI_E_RT_RECEIPT_*, GEORDI_E_RT_VIEWPORT_MISMATCH) are reported under this contract until the receipt has its own entry.
Rust items are read from source by crates/geordi-contract-api: no macro expansion, no name resolution, no auto traits.
The runtime negotiation API in crates/geordi-renderer (GeordiRayTracedRuntimeProfile) is not compared.
There is no TypeScript API for this contract.
